# Kybornos Provider

Terraform provider for Kybornos VDC infrastructure.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Kybornos Gateway API key. Can also be set using the `KYBORNOS_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `endpoint` (String) Kybornos Gateway API base URL. Can also be set using the `KYBORNOS_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
